standard.label: Standard
standard.description: Charcoal black, metallic gold, white and subtle silver presentation. Owner-managed static artwork uses the Standard image catalog; approved media retains priority.

notes: Standard Theme #1 is installed as the baseline; Owner theme selection and persistence belong to a future build.
Dynamic site-setting and approved R2 media take priority over static artwork.
Future themes should add complete palette, logo, banner, imagery and component override contracts.
